{"relevant": true, "severity": "info", "message": "Good move on httpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax in internal/auth/session.go. Since cookies are now sent automatically, SameSite=Lax alone doesn't cover CSRF for state-changing requests (same-site subdomains, GET handlers with side effects). Make sure mutating endpoints use POST/PUT/DELETE with a CSRF token or Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site check. Also confirm the cookie has a bounded Max-Age/Expires, Path=/, and (if possible) the `__Host-` prefix, and that the old token is no longer returned in response bodies or stored in localStorage/logs."}
